title: OAuthFlows
description: A container object nested in an oauth2-type SecurityScheme that maps each supported OAuth 2.0 grant type (implicit, password, clientCredentials, authorizationCode) to one OAuthFlow configuration. It holds no URLs or scopes of its own; it only selects which grant types the scheme offers. Use OAuthFlow instead when the element carries the authorizationUrl, tokenUrl, refreshUrl or scopes of a single grant type rather than the set of grant-type slots. Use SecurityScheme instead when the element declares the authentication mechanism itself (type, description, name/in, scheme) rather than the flows block inside an oauth2 scheme. Use Components instead when the element is the document-wide registry holding named securitySchemes, not the flows object within one scheme.
x-dr-evidence: A 'flows:' map with keys such as authorizationCode or clientCredentials under a securitySchemes entry whose type is oauth2 in openapi.yaml or openapi.json
A springdoc/swagger-annotations @OAuthFlows(...) passed as the flows argument of @SecurityScheme(type = SecuritySchemeType.OAUTH2)
A framework flows model instantiated for an OAuth2 scheme, e.g. FastAPI OAuthFlowsModel(password=...) or .NET Swashbuckle new OpenApiOAuthFlows { AuthorizationCode = ... }
